amendment_rule: Any material amendment requires a new version and must precede outcome inspection.

protocol.causal_scope: Immediate same-state command transmission conditional on the frozen factual state distribution; not a long-horizon counterfactual trajectory or safety effect.

decision_rules.command_level_masking: The upstream policy contrast is non-degenerate and the paired enabled-minus-monitor contrast reduces command separation with a 95% group-bootstrap interval below zero.
decision_rules.controller_insensitivity: The monitor-only nominal policy contrast is below the frozen denominator threshold; do not attribute the downstream null to the supervisor.
decision_rules.limited_power_or_unresolved: The interval crosses zero or parity/integrity gates fail; do not claim masking.

factual_rollout_treatments.factorisation: 2 predictor x 2 risk x 2 target x 20 init

primary_estimands.predictor_nominal_separation: |u_nom(P*) - u_nom(B1)| at matched risk and mapping
primary_estimands.retention_ratio: Delta_post / (Delta_monitor + epsilon), reported only above the frozen denominator threshold
primary_estimands.risk_nominal_separation: |u_nom(adaptive) - u_nom(fixed_medium)| at matched predictor and mapping
primary_estimands.supervisor_attenuation: Delta_post - Delta_monitor at the same state

required_state_freeze: SMPC previous control and warm-start snapshot
factual and shadow supervisor behaviour states
required_step_log: risk tightening and required probability mass
nominal acceleration, steering and desired speed
all seven supervisor candidate request/application flags
post-supervisor acceleration, steering and desired speed
proof that shadow branch was not actuated
protocol.scientific_question: For the same factual planning state, how much predictor- or risk-policy command separation is created by SMPC, and how much remains after the complete rule-based supervisor mapping?
smoke_gate: factual branch command equals the pre-shadow factual command within 1e-9
all eight shadow branches are logged on every eligible planning step
all seven authority channels are computed for enabled and monitor-only mappings
factual trajectory is unchanged relative to shadow-disabled execution within declared deterministic tolerance

solver_accounting.missing_or_nonfinite: fail closed for the affected state; reconcile counts

protocol.stopping_rule: Stop only after all 160 planned factual rollouts have valid receipts or after a predeclared infrastructure abort. No outcome-driven extension, cell replacement, threshold change or parameter search is allowed.

uncertainty.aggregation: mean within ego_init_id before population aggregation
